svg.title: Validation ladder from planned to covered
svg.desc: Three-rung validation ladder from planned to partial to covered. A side note marks internal self-agreement as insufficient for covered status. Explicit genomic GREML is covered at validation scale; interval rows remain separate. Live public_covered_count is taken from validation_status(), not this figure.

svg.text: Status words from validation_status(). Fill and position both encode the rung, not colour alone.
